# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 113 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 113 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_113_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 10, Chapter 3

**1** "Do you know these things now?" he asked me. "I know them, Lord," I said. "I know all these things from the words that I have heard from you." **2** "But there are other things beyond these," he said. "Many are you need; for I have not declared to you all things that you must do. But now listen carefully. **3** These things which are commanded to you, fulfill them and keep them. And those about which you have heard from the church — obey them. **4** And tell those who are leaders of the church that they may direct their steps in righteousness; so that they may obtain all righteousness and be cleansed and washed in the seal of the Son of God. **5** For this seal is the truth; so that those who bear this seal shall enter the kingdom of God. **6** Do not be idle in the things of the Lord. **7** For you, Hermas — you shall tell all those words to the elders of the church, and let this be proclaimed throughout the whole world. **8** And you shall say to all the leaders of the church that they may direct their steps with all righteousness; **9** that salvation and remission of sins may be theirs through the name of the Son of God, and through his great and glorious name shall they be made glorious." **10** And so the shepherd departed from me, and after him, the glorious One.

---

*EMET: the commission to the leaders of the church is the pastoral conclusion of the entire Shepherd. Righteousness + the seal of the Son of God = kingdom entry. The Shepherd's departure is understated and final.*
